subject: HSM operator Q&A + ephemeral-key evidence intake (SIG/CAIQ)
messages:
From: Tom Gray <tom.gray@lumenbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@lumenbank.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: ephemeral key proofs + operator Q&A for SIG/CAIQ intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the CAIQ. We have one follow-up bucket from our controls team focused on key lifecycle and operator controls for HSM-backed keys. Specifically they want:

- A short operator interview (10-20 min) to confirm shift handover and dual-control procedures.
- A sample of recent HSM shift logs (timestamp + operator id) covering a 30-day window.
- Evidence of ephemeral key handling for tenant-level wrap keys (manifest of captures, stamps, any nonce traces you can provide).

We understand some of these are sensitive; a redacted sample is fine so long as it preserves operator IDs and timestamps. Can you advise availability for an operator Q&A early next week? Also point us to a secure upload for the artifacts (we prefer DocuSign for attestation forms and GDrive for logs).

Tom
Tom Gray
Senior Information Security Analyst
Lumen Bank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Gray <tom.gray@lumenbank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral key proofs + operator Q&A for SIG/CAIQ intake

Tom — thanks for the clear list. We can handle all three asks but will need to coordinate operator schedules and a small redaction process for the logs. Proposed plan: 

1) Operator Q&A: 15-minute slot on Mon 2025-09-22 at 11:00 AM PT (we can also do Tue morning). Participants: our on-call HSM operator (Jonas) and me.

2) Shift logs: we'll produce a CSV sample (hsm_shiftlog_sample.csv) with timestamps, operator IDs (hashed but linkable internally), and operation type. We'll redact ephemeral material but keep sequence and timestamps intact.

3) Ephemeral key manifest: we will generate a short manifest (ephemeral-key-capture-manifest.txt) that lists capture IDs, wrapped-key references, and nonces in obfuscated form.

Attachments: we'll send an attestation form for your signature (operator-attestation-form.pdf) via DocuSign; logs we will upload to a secure GDrive folder and share a view-only link.

Next steps: if the proposed time works, I'll calendar the operator and share the DocuSign and Drive links. If you prefer a different timezone or a longer slot, tell me and we can expand.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral key proofs + operator Q&A for SIG/CAIQ intake

Marissa — noted. I can take the operator Q&A on Mon 9/22 at 11:00 AM PT. For the sample CSV I plan to:

- Pull shift logs for 2025-08-20 -> 2025-09-19 (30 days).
- Replace operator email/usernames with stable hashes (sha256 truncated), keep internal mapping in our secure store if Lumen needs traceability.
- Remove any full key material; show operation types (e.g., KEK_WRAP, KEY_GEN, OPERATOR_LOGIN) and sequence ids.

I'll prep the CSV and the ephemeral manifest. Irene, do you want to add anything for the manifest format or additional fields Lumen flagged in the CAIQ?

— Jonas
HSM Lead, Crypto Ops

From: Tom Gray <tom.gray@lumenbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@lumenbank.com
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral key proofs + operator Q&A for SIG/CAIQ intake

Marissa, Jonas — thanks, that time works for us. A couple of clarifications before the call:

1) For the operator attestation, our audit team needs a signed statement confirming the shift handover pattern (dual control) and whether emergency rewraps were executed and by whom (redacted id ok).
2) For the CSV, please include a column indicating whether the operation modified key material or was a read-only event.
3) We will accept DocuSign for the attestation and a Drive link for logs (view-only).

I'll attend the call with two folks from our audit group. We expect the session to be Q&A only — no live command execution.

Attached: signed-sig-ack.pdf (acknowledgment of scope).

Tom

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Gray <tom.gray@lumenbank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ephemeral key proofs + operator Q&A for SIG/CAIQ intake

Tom — appreciated. Post-call notes and what you'll receive by end of day Tuesday (2025-09-23):

- DocuSign: operator-attestation-form.pdf sent to security@lumenbank.com (please sign the attestation to close the control).
- Drive: shared folder with hsm_shiftlog_sample.csv (30-day window) and ephemeral-key-capture-manifest.txt. We redacted key material and used truncated SHA-256 for operator ids; there is a mapping table stored in our compliance vault if Lumen and your auditor need tape-trace verification under NDA.
- CSV includes a column "modifies_key_material" set to true/false and an operation_type column per your request.

Open items: if your auditors request a non-redacted mapping for operator ids we will need a signed NDA amendment and an approved access plan. Otherwise everything requested for SIG/CAIQ intake will be in the shared folder.

Thanks again — Jonas did a great job walking through shift handovers.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
